# Artifacts Phenomenon

**Artifacts of the Count**

*Four Sets, Two Archetypes, One Currency: Time*

Thal'vireth — Artifact Set Reference

All four sets below draw their power from the same source as everything else in Thal'vireth — fragments of chronoflow-touched soulstone, shaped into wearable form. None grant raw damage or defense the way ordinary magic items do. Instead, each set manipulates *tempo*: how fast a burst arrives, how long an advantage sustains, how much punishment can be stored and released, or how far back a moment can be pulled.

# **Adaptive Modifiers**

Each archetype uses a shared, scaling modifier instead of flat numbers, so these sets stay relevant from early to late levels without manual rebalancing. Calculate once per encounter (or once per rest) and reuse.

*DPS SETS  —  ADAPT MOD \= MAX(Dexterity Modifier, Strength Modifier, Intelligence Modifier) − 2, minimum 1\.*  
 *Usable by archers (DEX) /martial attackers (ATK) or casters (INT) alike — whichever is higher.*

*TANK SETS  —  FORT MOD \= MAX(Constitution Modifier, Wisdom Modifier) − 2, minimum 1\.*  
 *Usable by physical tanks (CON) or faith-based defenders (WIS) alike — whichever is higher.*

All stack-based effects cap at **4 stacks**, trigger on a single clear condition, and reset immediately after their payoff resolves. No percentages, no delayed/banked damage carried across turns.

**Litany of the High Priestess  DPS — SUSTAIN**

*Theme:* ritual ascension, a chant built verse by verse toward a burning noon.  **Identity:** steady ramp, extended peak window, then reset.

| Pieces | Bonus |
| :---- | :---- |
| **2-Piece** | Once per round, if you hit a target you already hit this round, deal \+ADAPT MOD bonus damage. |
| **5-Piece** | Gain 1 Verse per successful hit (max 4). Each active Verse adds \+ADAPT MOD damage to your next hit. At 4 Verses, enter Noon for 2 rounds: all your hits deal an additional \+1d6 damage. Verses reset to 0 when Noon ends. |

**Pieces**

| Piece | Minor Stat |
| :---- | :---- |
| Crown of the Unbroken Verse | \+1 Intelligence |
| Ring of the Ascending Chant | \+1 to spell attack rolls |
| Torque of the Solar Litany | \+1 Charisma |
| Greaves of the Noonward Step | \+10 ft movement speed |
| Memento of the Curia's Watch | \+1 AC |

**Judgment of the Ah K'in  DPS — BURST**

*Theme:* written fate, a verdict deferred until it can no longer be delayed.  **Identity:** quiet setup, single decisive detonation.

| Pieces | Bonus |
| :---- | :---- |
| **2-Piece** | Once per turn, when you deal damage, add \+ADAPT MOD force damage. |
| **5-Piece** | Gain 1 Glyph stack per successful hit (max 4). At 4 stacks, your next hit detonates: deal an additional \+(ADAPT MOD × 4\) bonus damage, then all stacks reset to 0\. |

**Pieces**

| Piece | Minor Stat |
| :---- | :---- |
| Diadem of the Deferred Glyph | \+1 Intelligence |
| Signet of the Waiting Verdict | \+1 to spell attack rolls |
| Torque of Jade Inscription | \+1 Charisma |
| Greaves of the Final Line | \+10 ft movement speed |
| Reliquary of the Unspoken Sentence | \+1 AC |

**Shroud of the Broken Deep  TANK — SHIELD**

*Theme:* underworld endurance, damage held at bay rather than simply absorbed.  **Identity:** active mitigation building toward a full block.

| Pieces | Bonus |
| :---- | :---- |
| **2-Piece** | Once per turn, reduce incoming damage by FORT MOD. |
| **5-Piece** | Gain 1 Grave stack whenever you take damage (max 4). Each active Grave stack grants \+1 AC. At 4 stacks, the next hit that would deal damage to you is fully absorbed (0 damage), then all stacks reset to 0\. |

**Pieces**

| Piece | Minor Stat |
| :---- | :---- |
| Mask of the Thirteen Wardens | \+1 Wisdom |
| Ring of the Sunless Root | \+1 Constitution |
| Torque of the Hollowed Vigil | \+1 Strength, \+1 to grapple checks |
| Greaves of the Descending Watch | Ignore difficult terrain |
| Bone-Token of Xibal Root | \+1 AC |

**Weave of the Deep Count  TANK — HP**

*Theme:* preservation, a moment held in reserve against the moment that would end it.  **Identity:** passive sustain with a one-time rewind.

| Pieces | Bonus |
| :---- | :---- |
| **2-Piece** | Once per turn, when you fail a saving throw, add \+FORT MOD to the result. |
| **5-Piece** | Whenever you drop below 60% HP, gain 1 Weave stack (max 4, can retrigger). Each active Weave stack heals you FORT MOD HP at the start of your turn. At 4 stacks: if you would drop to 0 HP, instead return to your HP value from 2 rounds prior. Once per long rest. |

**Pieces**

| Piece | Minor Stat |
| :---- | :---- |
| Headdress of the Held Moment | \+1 Wisdom |
| Ring of Returning Breath | \+1 Constitution |
| Threaded Torque of the Deep Count | \+1 Charisma, \+1 to saving throws |
| Greaves of the Waning Root | On disengage, \+2 AC until the start of your next turn |
| Memento of the Kept Hour | \+1 AC |

*Design note: piece names were reworked from an earlier Maya-deity-named revision to tie each set directly to Thal'vireth's own hierarchy and districts (the High Priestess, the Ah K'in, Xibal Root, the Deep Count) rather than borrowed pantheon names.*
